initial.title: [v0.92.1][V3-F] Repair Sprint 5/6 cutover blockers
initial.goal: Repair the concrete Sprint 5/6 cutover-review blockers while keeping C-SDLC v2 as live authority until #505.
initial.required_outcome: The remediation PR has typed local lifecycle state, uses typed GitHub operations, fixes reviewed v2/v3 defects with behavior-backed proof, and remains explicitly non-authoritative for v3 cutover.
authority_boundary: C-SDLC v2 remains live authority until explicit #505 cutover
PR #597 must not close #596 until #596 has truthful bound, reviewed, published, and reconciled lifecycle state
No merge, finish, cleanup, or v3 authority cutover is authorized by this issue
Raw gh is not used for covered lifecycle writes
operator_constraints: Do not work on primary main
Do not use /private/tmp for generated task artifacts
Use typed C-SDLC v2 operations for covered lifecycle state
Capture defects found while testing real issues for later resolution
initial.task_boundary: Bounded remediation of sprint review blockers and typed-tool canary defects needed before #505 can be reviewed for cutover.
deliverables: Remediation PR body with visible Closes #596 and non-closing Part-Of #505/#534 linkage after #596 has passed typed lifecycle review
Typed GitHub PR create/update operations with owner provenance and idempotent update safety
Single csdlc v3 binary and standalone locked CI coverage
Behavior-backed v3 importer, durability, review, finish, and cleanup fixes
Real issue canary evidence for #592, OBS-A/#511, and OBS-B/#512
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: #596 has canonical local C-SDLC v2 issue state with SIP, STP, SPP, VPP, SRP, and SOR cards
AC-2: The remediation PR uses visible Closes #596 and non-closing Part-Of #505/#534 linkage only after #596 has been bound, implemented, reviewed, and publication-reconciled
AC-3: PR body create/update operations are performed through typed C-SDLC v2 GitHub owners, not raw gh
AC-4: Repeated PR update operation keys cannot overwrite a different governed body
AC-5: v3 durable transaction proof fails closed across projection crash windows
AC-6: v3 construction remains non-authoritative until #505 cutover
AC-7: Focused v2, v3, CI-policy, canary, and diff-hygiene validation passes before handoff
non_goals: Cut over from C-SDLC v2 to v3
Hide unrelated sprint defects in the remediation PR
Use raw GitHub CLI for covered lifecycle writes
initial.plan_summary: Create the typed lifecycle record, repair the idempotency and durability defects found by review, rerun focused proof, push the remediation branch, and re-check PR #597 without touching main.

steps.action: Create canonical typed six-card lifecycle state for #596.
Verify the remediation PR linkage so it visibly Closes #596 while keeping #505/#534 as non-closing Part-Of links until their own lifecycle gates complete.
Make typed PR update idempotency operation-key bound and add regression proof.
Close the v3 durable projection crash window and add regression proof.
Run focused validation, push, and refresh PR #597 readback.

invariants: Primary checkout remains clean on main
V2 remains the only live lifecycle authority
PR #597 does not close #596/#505/#534 before typed lifecycle authority exists
Durable recovery must fail closed after committed state but missing projections
Operation keys must be replay-safe and conflict-detecting
risks: Leaving PR transport as caller-forgeable or replay-unsafe
Claiming v3 cutover before independent #505 review
Recording local canaries as stronger evidence than they are
stop_conditions: Primary checkout is no longer clean on main
Typed C-SDLC v2 owner refuses required lifecycle mutation
Fix requires widening beyond sprint remediation

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove typed PR create/update action validation, owner provenance, and idempotent conflict rejection.
Prove durable projection repair remains required across committed-state/missing-projection crash windows.
Run focused CI-policy, canary, all-target v3, and diff-hygiene checks for the remediation branch.

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on stale lifecycle state, missing typed issue cards, closing linkage to #505, non-idempotent PR update replay, projection repair ambiguity, or failed focused validation.
review_prompts: Does PR #597 avoid closing #596 until canonical local lifecycle state exists?
Can the same PR update operation key overwrite a different body?
Can a crash after durable state commit but before projection write reopen as complete?
Does any evidence claim v3 authority before #505?
initial.review_scope: Sprint 5/6 remediation branch, #596 lifecycle state, PR #597 linkage, typed PR transport, and v3 durable projection recovery only.
